objective: Schedule a small EV fleet for V2G support during a critical-load outage window while preserving reserve state of charge.

objective.en: Maximize critical-load energy served by an EV fleet subject to charger power and reserve SOC constraints.
objective.ru: Максимизировать энергию критической нагрузки, покрытую EV-флотом, с учётом ограничений зарядной мощности и резервного SOC.

instructions.en: Use v2g_outage_case. For each outage interval and EV, choose dispatch_kw: positive discharges to the critical-load bus, negative charges. Respect each EV's charge/discharge limits, capacity, efficiency, and reserve SOC. Report dispatch_kw by timestamp, served_energy_kwh, and final_soc_kwh.
instructions.ru: Используйте v2g_outage_case. Для каждого интервала аварии и EV выберите dispatch_kw: положительное значение разряжает EV в шину критической нагрузки, отрицательное заряжает. Соблюдайте ограничения мощности, ёмкости, КПД и резервного SOC каждого EV. Укажите dispatch_kw по интервалам, served_energy_kwh и final_soc_kwh.

submission_schema.dispatch_kw: object mapping timestamp to EV kW commands
submission_schema.served_energy_kwh: critical-load energy served over the event

hard_constraints: Commands must satisfy EV power limits and reserve SOC constraints.
Served energy and final SOC must match the independent enumeration optimum within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted V2G schedule satisfies all hard constraints.

source_provenance.title: The Role of Electrical Vehicles for Power Quality and Security during Outages in the Distribution Grid
source_provenance.notes: Grounds EV/V2G outage-support scheduling; the task uses explicit energy/SOC constraints.
